messages:
inc-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected on model-runner-prod (service:model-runner, region:us-west-2). 5xx spike from 00:09:10, >12% errors in 5m window. Paging on-call.
ashley: I’m on-call, seeing the alert. checking dashboards now.
ashley: mattrun? anyone already looking at logs or has a pointer to the greenlet crash traces?
matt: I was looking at a different alert, jumping in. what models affected?
ashley: runtime shows crashes in model-runner instances servicing model:v1-large and v1-large-quant. traces show segfaults in native kernel during attention kernels.
tania: saw repeated OOM then segfault on a couple of hosts -> kernel message: "double free or corrupted" in libattention.so. attaching the last 3 lines from host-10.2.4.9: ```Mar 15 00:09:07 model-runner[3278]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8b1c2a0b3d sp 00007ffe7b2c7f40 error 4 in libattention.so[7f8b1c200000+12000]```
paul: hmm, pattern looks like long-context requests building large KV cache combined with batching. load jumped when two large prompt jobs started at ~00:08.
ashley: immediate mitigation suggestions?
matt: two quick mitigations: 1) route traffic for v1-large -> v1-small-quant fallback; 2) reduce batch size to 1 on affected pools. both are quick routing/config changes.
ashley: lucy from support - any customer complaints yet?
lucy: got two p0 tickets from customers in prod using chat endpoints, reports of 502/504s. they're impacted. added to incident.
ashley: OK prioritize routing. matt, can you flip routing? I’ll reduce batching config.
matt: doing traffic reroute now -> switching traffic for model:v1-large to model:v1-small-quant in us-west-2. command: ```/deploy route set --from model:v1-large --to model:v1-small-quant --region us-west-2 --weight 100```
matt: routing change applied. hitting deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Route update event: v1-large -> v1-small-quant (100%) by matt at 00:12.
tania: decreasing batch size on pool gpu-pool-west: ```PATCH /admin/pool/gpu-pool-west {"batch_size":1, "max_latency_ms":200}```
tania: batch size reduced, pool config acked.
ashley: can we also enable circuit-breaker for long sequences to prevent KV blowup? pausing long-seq inference > 16k tokens.
ashley: command: ```/admin circuit set --rule long_seq_kv --threshold 16000 --action reject```
paul: circuit rule in place.
ashley: monitoring error rate. anyone seeing improvement?
sre-rohit: logs show immediate drop in segfault signal rates from host fleet. 5xx rate down to 3% in last 2m.
lucy: customers reporting partial recovery, one customer still seeing intermittent 504s but much fewer.
matt: plan to restart the 3 hosts that showed the segfault traces after draining traffic. I'll drain, restart, and tail logs.
matt: drain commands: ```/admin node drain host-10.2.4.9``` then ```systemctl restart model-runner```
matt: restarted host-10.2.4.9, monitoring. logs after restart show no segfaults for 4m.
tania: rolling restart on the other two affected hosts completed.
ashley: good. we should capture core dumps and upload to S3 for offline analysis. pauldoc?
paul: already collected cores from all three hosts and uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-archives/2176543210/ with metadata. posted links in the incident ticket.
ashley: root-cause hypothesis: attention kernel has an unsafe free path when KV cache grows beyond threshold under certain quantization code path. triggers double-free occasionally.
sre-rohit: agrees. reproduced locally by sending long-context traffic with batching on quantized runner. filed a bug: INF-9873. assigned to eng-runtime.
matt: immediate next steps: keep fallback routing active for 2 hours, keep batch_size=1 on gpu-pool-west, monitor. create a canary with patched memory-safety build tomorrow.
lucy: support notifying affected customers now: template sent to P0s, offering rollback and mitigation summary.
ashley: timeline for a proper patch? eng-runtime estimate?
paul: eng-runtime (assigned) estimates 48-72h for a tested fix and kernel update, then canary deploy.
ashley: fine. action items: - matt: keep fallback routing and monitor (in progress) - tania: leave batch config at 1, create dashboard alert for KV growth (todo) - paul: attach repro and cores to INF-9873 (done) - rohit: follow up with eng-runtime for timeline (todo) - lucy: continue customer comms (in progress)
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place; error rate reduced to baseline. Incident assigned INF-9873 for follow-up.
ashley: closing the paging loop for now, will handoff to postmortem channel for RCA. thanks all. :thumbsup:
paul: copying notes into postmortem doc and scheduling RCA sync for tomorrow 09:00 PST.
lucy: keeping customers updated until fix is deployed.
ashley: last check in 00:40 — errors stable ~1.2%. marking incident as mitigated.
inc-bot: INCIDENT: resolved (mitigated) at 00:40.
